Usage: clk [OPTIONS] COMMAND [ARGS]...

  A click based tool.

Options:
  --level [debug|info|warning]  Log level
  --dry-run / --no-dry-run      Do not change anything
  -n, --name TEXT               Name to use
  --help                        Show this message and exit.

Commands:
  publish  Publish a package
  sync     Synchronise state
